"""Capture every full-novel cache comparison using the verified Nix executable."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, '/home/josh/projects/klem/tools')
from hada_remaining_audit import ROOT, read, sha
p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
p.add_argument('--cli',type=Path,required=True)
p.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
a=p.parse_args(); assert not a.output.exists()
package=read(ROOT/'docs/hada-remaining-packaged-checks.json.gz')
assert str(a.cli)==package['nix_outputs']['klem']+'/bin/klem'
assert sha(a.cli)==package['cli_sha256']
book=ROOT/'data/books/mujeong.txt'; db=ROOT/'data/dictionaries/krdict/krdict.db'
streams=[]
for mode,flags in [('raw',[]),('headword',['--dict-only']),('compatible',['--dict-compatible'])]:
 checks=[]
 for cache in [0,8388608]:
  command=[str(a.cli),'text',str(book),'--dictionary',str(db),*flags,'--cache-bytes',str(cache)]
  h=hashlib.sha256();count=0
  proc=subprocess.Popen(command,stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
  assert proc.stdout is not None
  for line in proc.stdout:h.update(line);count+=1
  code=proc.wait();assert code==0 and count==179112
  checks.append({'command':command,'records':count,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'exit_code':code})
  print(mode,cache,count,h.hexdigest(),flush=True)
 assert checks[0]['sha256']==checks[1]['sha256']
 streams.append({'mode':mode,'checks':checks})
producer=Path(__file__)
report={'schema_version':1,'cli_sha256':sha(a.cli),'book_sha256':sha(book),'dictionary_sha256':sha(db),'streams':streams,'producer':{'text':producer.read_text(),'sha256':sha(producer)}}
a.output.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
